tasks.name: development_direct_set_x
tasks.prompt: Set x to K. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: development_direct_set_y
tasks.prompt: Set y to L. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: heldout_direct_set_x
tasks.prompt: Set x to R. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: heldout_direct_set_y
tasks.prompt: Set y to N. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: development_conditional_set_x
tasks.prompt: If x is EMPTY, set x to K. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: development_conditional_set_y
tasks.prompt: If y is LOW, set y to HIGH. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: heldout_conditional_set_x
tasks.prompt: If x is COLD, set x to WARM. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: heldout_conditional_set_y
tasks.prompt: If y is OFF, set y to ON. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: development_replacement_x
tasks.prompt: Change x from A to B. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: development_replacement_y
tasks.prompt: Change y from C to D. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: heldout_replacement_x
tasks.prompt: Change x from M to N. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.

tasks.name: heldout_replacement_y
tasks.prompt: Change y from P to Q. Finish when the requested external state has been achieved.
